requirement_text.REQ-367: User request: automatically deploy to qa.bizdala.com whenever a merge to main changes deployable application code. Confirmed scope, per explicit user decision after being shown the alternative: deploy ON MERGE TO MAIN, not a live preview environment per open PR -- QA is one shared, serially-updated instance (one Compose project, one nginx vhost, confirmed this session), and per-PR ephemeral environments would be substantially more infrastructure with no existing precedent anywhere in this project. DO NOT INVENT A NEW DEPLOY MECHANISM -- THIS PATTERN ALREADY EXISTS AND IS PROVEN. The sibling tvolodi/letflow-queue repo already runs exactly this shape in production: .github/workflows/cd.yml triggers after CI passes on master, SSHes into its target host over a purpose-built, tightly restricted deploy key, and re-runs a deploy/redeploy-test.sh script. This was built, live-fired for real, and its restricted key was proven to reject an actually-destructive command over the same channel. Full detail: ai-dala-infra's tasks/T-0111-provision-letflow-queue-cd-deploy-key.md. This requirement adapts that exact shape for letflow-3/QA rather than designing a new one -- citing a different mechanism without a stated reason to diverge is itself a finding to report, not something to do quietly. WHY THIS REPO'S OWN EXISTING deploy/redeploy-test.sh IS NOT REUSABLE AS-IS. That script targets a DIFFERENT, unrelated environment (/opt/apps/letflow-test on a host referred to as 'hetzner-prod' in its own header comment, Compose project letflow-test) -- not /opt/apps/letflow-qa on ubuntu-16gb-nbg1-1, which is where qa.bizdala.com actually runs. Its own header comment claims 'Automatically, by .github/workflows/cd.yml' invocation, but no such workflow exists anywhere in this repo -- that comment is stale/aspirational, not a real wiring, and must not be treated as evidence this capability already exists for QA. This requirement creates a NEW script, deploy/redeploy-qa.sh, targeting the real QA path, rather than repurposing or renaming the stale one (which may still be needed for its own actual target later -- do not delete it as part of this requirement, it is out of scope). QA'S DEPLOY SHAPE IS TWO ARTEFACTS, NOT ONE -- DIFFERENT FROM letflow-queue'S SINGLE-IMAGE CASE. Per this session's own prior manual QA deploys (T-0125/T-0128/T-0129/T-0131, ai-dala-infra), a full QA redeploy is: (1) git pull the checkout, (2) rebuild the backend Docker image and docker compose up -d --force-recreate app, (3) rebuild the frontend static bundle via a throwaway node:22 container (no Node installed on the host, per the minimal-footprint precedent) with the real VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY/VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID build args and atomically swap it into /opt/apps/letflow-qa/web-dist/ (backing up the previous build first, matching the pattern already used manually), (4) health-check both (/health for the backend, curl -sf https://qa.bizdala.com/ for the frontend shell). Do not restart nginx or the Keycloak container -- neither changes as part of an application-code deploy, and restarting either unnecessarily is itself a needless blast-radius increase. TRIGGER CONDITION -- REUSE CI's EXISTING PATH FILTER, DO NOT REBUILD DIFF LOGIC. .github/workflows/ci.yml's changes job already computes backend/frontend boolean outputs from a real git diff against the base SHA. This requirement's new cd.yml must gate its deploy job on needs.changes.outputs.backend == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.frontend == 'true' (reusing the SAME changes job -- via workflow_run triggering off ci.yml's own completion, matching letflow-queue's own trigger mechanism, or an equivalent that avoids a second independent diff computation) so a docs-only merge does not trigger a redeploy at all. Do not write a second, parallel path-filter regex. CREDENTIALS ARE OUT OF THIS REQUIREMENT'S OWN SCOPE -- SEE THE COMPANION ai-dala-infra TASK. This requirement's acceptance criteria stop at 'the workflow file and script exist, are correct, and are provably ready to receive a working deploy key' -- they do NOT include actually provisioning the SSH key, setting GitHub Actions secrets, or making any change to the ubuntu-16gb-nbg1-1 host. That is a credential-provisioning action requiring host access this repo's own pipeline does not have -- it is a companion ai-dala-infra task, following T-0111's own exact precedent (fresh purpose-built key, command= restriction proven with a live destructive-command test, secrets set by the user directly via gh secret set on tvolodi/letflow since agents do not have write access to this repo's own GitHub Actions secrets). This requirement's own close-out states plainly that the deploy is NOT live until that companion task lands, rather than implying completion it hasn't reached.
